brief: riverRun() = 1 + RIVER_SWING * greyF() has said since #145 that the channel runs x1.45 in January and x0.55 in July. It has FIFTEEN call sites and every one of them is colour, drift speed, streak count, streak length, millSpin, the fountain, or the deep-channel gradient in groundBase. Not one moves the WATERLINE: RIVER_X0 114..RIVER_X1 127 is a build-time constant, and the census's `water` has read 8784 (976 cells x 9 samples) for forty iterations. So the river is the last big surface in the town where the season changes how it LOOKS and not where it IS. Give it a level at the margin: high water in winter laps up over the reed shallows and toward the towpath, a low late summer uncovers a strip of wet stone and reed roots at the edge. Build it on the machinery #181 already has — buildIce/stepIce enumerate the margin as an L1 distance transform out from every cell the channel is NOT, and riverMid(x) already says where the current is too fast for anything to happen.
successLooksLike: A probe on the pattern of probes/river-ice.mjs, 6 seeds x a year, reporting the wetted margin as a CURVE with a winter maximum and a late-summer minimum — not a switch; quote the most cells that cross a drawn bucket in one tick, as #181 did (it was 13). The bank strip is uncovered on N days and exactly 0 on the rest. Boats, ducks, swans, the mirror and the ice are all still correct at BOTH extremes, and the winter census row moves.
avoid: NEITHER census block can see the low-water end. The three summer ages all sit at warmth 0.6929 by design (#14) and #187's winter block is pinned at warp 1220, so expect the summer nine UNCHANGED and say so in the brief's own words rather than promising a delta you cannot get — that trap cost #181 a whole paragraph. Prove the summer end with your own probe. A level that flips tiles is a grid change: re-pin with census.mjs --save-baseline and check `developed` and `green` did not absorb what `water` lost. And keep it a MARGIN — do not narrow the navigable channel or the punts, the barge and the rowboat all need re-pricing.
